_comment: LLM-provider API hosts the harness's MODEL traffic goes to directly, never through the research egress proxy pool (scripts/proxy). The pool exists so COLLECTORS touch target infrastructure from a research IP; a model provider is not a target, and routing its API through those exits made phases slow or time out (a probe took 20 s via the pool vs 8 s direct, and a dead exit reads as 'backend unavailable', triggering a needless failover). backend_select.bypass_proxy_for_models() appends these to NO_PROXY for model CLIs only; collector processes keep the pool. A leading dot matches every subdomain (curl / Node / reqwest / Bun NO_PROXY semantics).
